claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a red cylinder with a valve, but no readable capacity marking; the report lists cylinder capacity as not shown.
No import or origin documents are shown; the report cannot confirm prior foreign use from photos.

risks.risk: Gas content level is unknown (full or empty).
risks.proof: Photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale showing its weight, or a clip of gas flowing when the valve is opened.
Close-up photo of the capacity marking stamped on the cylinder collar or body.

risks.risk: Certification or expiry date may be missing or expired.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the certification stamp and expiry date on the cylinder collar.

risks.risk: Hidden leaks or damage to the valve or body.
risks.proof: Video clip of a leak test using soap solution on the valve and seams.

risks.risk: Regulator and hose may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo showing a regulator and hose together with the cylinder.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the capacity marking on the cylinder collar or body.
Close-up photo of the certification stamp and expiry date.
Video clip of a leak test on the valve and seams.
Photo showing any regulator and hose included.
Photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale to confirm fill level.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a gas cylinder, so it can be valued at its worst case pending proof of capacity, certification, leaks, fill level, and included accessories.
